cond_0001.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
Professional knowledge of concepts, principles, theories, and practices involved in engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles to perform studies, modify standard practices, and/or resolve issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of the characteristics and performance of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in order to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings which are appropriate for the intended audience; and to maintain good working relationships.
[Location masked] Citizenship.
Must be able to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). A non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
This position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP). Employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
Employee must maintain current certifications.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
The employee may be required to travel in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
The work is primarily sedentary. Items carried typically include briefcases, notebooks, working papers, references, data print outs, and suitcases. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meetings.
The workspace is adequately heated, lighted, and ventilated. There is occasional noise from office equipment, such as printers, fax machines, and telephones. The employee is required to perform in varying office and meeting environments.
The incumbent observes normal safety precautions when working in and travelling away from the work site.
EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION QUALIFICATION, and FOREIGN EDUCATION QUALIFICATION: Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards; for additional information refer to the General Schedule (GS) qualifications link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series
This position is a Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel Systems (DCIPS) position. Work Category is Professional and Work Level is Entry/Developmental. For more information regarding DCIPS, including Veteran's Preference, please visit https://dcips.defense.gov/. If claiming Veteran's Preference, please include your DD214. If not provided, then Veteran's Preference will not be considered.
How you will be evaluated
You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above. Link to GS Qualifications for additional information: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, shaping next generation weapons systems, and informing the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and regularly communicating findings — either individually or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is to provide professional and scientific knowledge in work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0006.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Regularly communicates findings and stays in contact with team members and stakeholders through meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance, actively contributing to discussions and clarifying requirements for colleagues and leadership.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0006.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Professional knowledge of concepts, principles, theories, and practices involved in engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles to perform studies, modify standard practices, and/or resolve issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of the characteristics and performance of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in order to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings appropriate for the intended audience; and to maintain good working relationships.
[Location masked] Citizenship.
Ability to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). A non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
Drug testing: this position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP). Employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
Employee must maintain current certifications.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Preferred Requirements
Skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
The employee may be required to travel in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
The work is primarily sedentary. Items carried typically include briefcases, notebooks, working papers, references, data print outs, and suitcases. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meetings.
The workspace is adequately heated, lighted, and ventilated. There is occasional noise from office equipment, such as printers, fax machines, and telephones. The employee is required to perform in varying office and meeting environments.
The incumbent observes normal safety precautions when working in and travelling away from the work site.
EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION QUALIFICATION, and FOREIGN EDUCATION QUALIFICATION: Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards; for additional information refer to the General Schedule (GS) qualifications link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

cond_0016.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, informing next generation weapons systems, and reaching the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and producing technical reporting either individually or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.

Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.

cond_0050.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with intelligence analysis and engineering assessment work.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0050.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0050.requirements:
Professional knowledge of concepts, principles, theories, and practices involved in engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles to perform studies, modify standard practices, and/or resolve issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of the characteristics and performance of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in order to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings which are appropriate for the intended audience; and to maintain good working relationships.

cond_0055.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0055.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0055.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
Professional knowledge of concepts, principles, theories, and practices involved in engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles to perform studies, modify standard practices, and/or resolve issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of the characteristics and performance of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in order to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings which are appropriate for the intended audience; and to maintain good working relationships.
[Location masked] Citizenship.
Must be able to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). A non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
This position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP). Employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
Employee must maintain current certifications.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
The employee may be required to travel in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
The work is primarily sedentary. Items carried typically include briefcases, notebooks, working papers, references, data print outs, and suitcases. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meetings.
The workspace is adequately heated, lighted, and ventilated. There is occasional noise from office equipment, such as printers, fax machines, and telephones. The employee is required to perform in varying office and meeting environments.
The incumbent observes normal safety precautions when working in and travelling away from the work site.
EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION QUALIFICATION, and FOREIGN EDUCATION QUALIFICATION: Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards; for additional information refer to the General Schedule (GS) qualifications link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series
This position is a Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel Systems (DCIPS) position. Work Category is Professional and Work Level is Entry/Developmental. For more information regarding DCIPS, including Veteran's Preference, please visit https://dcips.defense.gov/. If claiming Veteran's Preference, please include your DD214. If not provided, then Veteran's Preference will not be considered.
How you will be evaluated
You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above. Link to GS Qualifications for additional information: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

cond_0075.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0075.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0075.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of engineering concepts, principles, theories, and practices, along with related mathematics and scientific principles, sufficient to perform studies and contribute to analysis of foreign systems.
Familiarity with security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, including technical reports, position papers, and briefings appropriate for the intended audience.
[Location masked] Citizenship.
Ability to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI); a non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
This position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP); employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
Preferred Requirements
Background in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems — this can be developed on the job.
Openness to understanding the impact of changing technology over time.
Experience maintaining current certifications, or willingness to obtain relevant certifications.
Willingness to travel occasionally in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
Comfort working in varying office and meeting environments, with normal safety precautions observed.
Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards. This is a DCIPS position with a Work Category of Professional and Work Level of Entry/Developmental. If claiming Veteran's Preference, please include your DD214.

cond_0085.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of engineering analysis applied to foreign systems and intelligence problems.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0085.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0085.requirements:
Professional knowledge of concepts, principles, theories, and practices involved in engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles to perform studies, modify standard practices, and/or resolve issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of the characteristics and performance of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in order to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings which are appropriate for the intended audience; and to maintain good working relationships.
Must have a bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
[Location masked] Citizenship Required
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
Position is designated special-sensitive and incumbent must be able to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). A non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide
Drug Testing: This position has been designated by the Air Force as a Testing Designated Position (TDP) under the Air Force Civilian Testing Program. Employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
Employee must maintain current certifications.
Disclosure of Political Appointments
The employee may be required to travel in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
The work is primarily sedentary. Items carried typically include briefcases, notebooks, working papers, references, data print outs, and suitcases. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meetings.
The workspace is adequately heated, lighted, and ventilated. There is occasional noise from office equipment, such as printers, fax machines, and telephones. The employee is required to perform in varying office and meeting environments.
The incumbent observes normal safety precautions when working in and travelling away from the work site.

cond_0116.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll own your technical development by applying your engineering expertise directly to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, shaping next generation weapons systems, and informing the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and delivering informed reporting either independently or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to apply professional and scientific knowledge in work requiring engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. You will execute general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to advance the organization's mission objectives.

cond_0214.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, informing next generation weapons systems, and reaching the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and producing technical reporting either individually or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.

cond_0219.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0219.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of engineering concepts, principles, theories, and practices, along with related mathematics and scientific principles, sufficient to perform studies and contribute to analysis of foreign systems.
Familiarity with security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, including technical reports, position papers, and briefings appropriate for the intended audience.
[Location masked] Citizenship.
Ability to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI); a non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
This position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP); employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
Preferred Requirements
Background in applying analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems — this can be developed on the job.
Openness to understanding the impact of changing technology over time.
Experience maintaining current certifications, or willingness to obtain relevant certifications.
Willingness to travel occasionally in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
Comfort working in varying office and meeting environments, with normal safety precautions observed.
Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards. This is a DCIPS position with a Work Category of Professional and Work Level of Entry/Developmental. If claiming Veteran's Preference, please include your DD214.

cond_0229.intro:

You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.

cond_0314.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll own your technical development by applying your engineering expertise directly to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, shaping next generation weapons systems, and informing the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and delivering informed reporting either independently or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to apply professional and scientific knowledge in work requiring engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. You will execute general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to advance the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.

cond_0339.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process, working closely with your team and connecting regularly with colleagues across mission areas. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and informing the highest levels of government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or as part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.

Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.

cond_0344.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact our national security by advising senior military planners, impacting next generation weapons systems, and even informing the highest levels of our government. Your work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and providing informed reporting either as an individual or part of a team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Applies general engineering knowledge in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Resume Requirements (PLEASE READ):
The following information must be included on your resume. If not included, your resume will not be considered.
· When including a part-time position on a resume, you must list the hours worked per week and the dates of employment (i.e., month/year to month/year or month/year to present).
· Resumes must include unique experiences for each position held and should not merge all experiences into a single section.
· Current Federal civilian employees must list the pay plan, series, and grade (i.e. GG-0801-09) for all Federal civilian positions held.
· Do NOT include photographs (or links to social media such as LinkedIn), inappropriate material, inappropriate content, nor personal information such as age, gender, religion, social security number, etc., on the resume.
cond_0344.responsibilities:
Applies engineering knowledge in analysis and assessment of foreign research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex electronics systems to support the organization's mission objectives.
Utilizes scientific inquiry in the development of models/simulations and/or computer programs to evaluate and predict the ability to support assigned projects, studies, or problems.
Provides technical guidance, advisory support, and assistance.
Attends meetings, conferences, briefings, and seminars related to program planning, advanced technologies, and support system concepts.
Accomplishes professional development and maintains technical proficiency.
cond_0344.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Deep expertise in concepts, principles, theories, and practices of engineering, and related mathematics and scientific principles, with a demonstrated ability to perform studies, modify standard practices, and resolve complex issues related to the analysis and predictive assessment of foreign systems capable of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, denying, or destroying [Location masked] defense systems.
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Advanced knowledge of security procedures to maintain control of classified material.
Strong command of analytical and evaluative techniques and intelligence analysis and production tradecraft to identify, investigate, and resolve complex issues or problems.
Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, with a proven ability to produce highly technical reports, position papers, and briefings appropriate for varied audiences, and to maintain effective working relationships.
[Location masked] Citizenship required.
Must be able to obtain and retain a TOP SECRET (TS) security clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). A non-disclosure agreement must be signed.
Must be registered for Selective Service, see Legal and Regulatory Guide.
Drug Testing: This position has been designated as a Testing Designated Position (TDP). Employee must pass initial and periodic drug testing.
Employee must maintain current certifications.
All new DCIPS employees are required to complete a two-year DCIPS trial period.
This position is subject to provisions of the DoD Priority Placement Program.
Disclosure of Political Appointments.
Preferred Requirements
Proven ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.
Positions which require polygraph testing as an inherent primary requirement of their position: Incumbent will be subject to periodic polygraph testing.
The employee may be required to travel in military and/or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
The work is primarily sedentary. Items carried typically include briefcases, notebooks, working papers, references, data print outs, and suitcases. A moderate amount of standing and walking is required in getting to and from meetings.
The workspace is adequately heated, lighted, and ventilated. There is occasional noise from office equipment, such as printers, fax machines, and telephones. The employee is required to perform in varying office and meeting environments.
The incumbent observes normal safety precautions when working in and travelling away from the work site.
Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Qualification Standards. This position is a Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel Systems (DCIPS) position. Work Category is Professional and Work Level is Entry/Developmental. If claiming Veteran's Preference, please include your DD214. If not provided, then Veteran's Preference will not be considered.

Ability to foresee the impact of changing technology.

cond_0630.intro:
Engineers at [Company name masked] generally begin their careers assigned to one of our intelligence production teams. You'll develop technical intelligence skills by working alongside colleagues and applying your engineering expertise to the intelligence production process. Each team has a classified mission focus on areas including: aircraft, spacecraft, missile systems, and cyberspace, as well as specific electronic systems such as radars, navigation, communications/data links, jammers, electro-optical sensors, and directed energy weapons and how our adversaries use them. The results of your work directly impact national security by informing senior military planners, shaping next generation weapons systems, and advising the highest levels of government. Work can involve modeling and simulation, reverse engineering, assessing multiple classes of information, and contributing to reporting in coordination with your team.
This listing will be used to assess candidates for multiple vacancies during the spring cycle.
You must be a [Location masked] citizen to be eligible for a position at [Company name masked], and you must be able/willing to obtain/maintain a Top Secret security clearance. A non-disclosure agreement must be signed upon hire.
The primary purpose of this position is: to provide professional and scientific knowledge in performance of work requiring the application of engineering, mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling/simulation, and/or other scientific principles, methods, and techniques. Supports the organization's mission objectives through shared effort in the planning, research, design, development, test, evaluation, integration, acquisition, dissemination, sustainment, modification, and/or exploitation of complex systems.

cond_0646.intro:
